BBW takes pride in its entrepreneurial heritage of more than 80 years. Having grown and evolved from a humble trading store, the BBW hallmark is now all about creating world-class retail environments that offer compelling and luxurious shopping experiences.

We are the ultimate brand for brands in Asia, bringing to the region some of the world’s most desired and beloved brands and introducing cutting-edge retail concepts.

Among our business priorities are sustainable growth and the desire to create value out of our people and the brands we represent.

Fashion a career with us: The key to our success is in being a fully integrated specialist with in-house expertise in all aspects of the retail industry, enabling us to provide end-to-end solutions to our brand partners and stakeholders. There’s always something exciting taking place or in the works and you get to take part in it.
